Assets added to the material library lock on 2026-11-12 (diffuse, normal and roughness maps, 1k and 2k jpg,
via https://api.polyhaven.com/files/<id>, pinned by md5 in tools/blender/materials/polyhaven.lock.json),
for the snow of the 3D HollowMere scene (tools/blender/meshy_village_build.py):
